### Music from Berlin: A.S. Fanning & Badhands

![A.S. Fanning](news/steve.jpg)

We are bringing Berlin-based Irish gothic-folk singer-songwriter A.S. Fanning to town! Steve will be playing on the closing night of the Fringe, ably supported by Badhands.

[Watch Steve at the legendary Rockpalast](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0Y4qdDd2WfA&t=1974s)

### Door Policy
All attendees must be members or guests of members to comply with our membership-only policy. We offer the opportunity to sign up for membership at the door. Members may also bring guests, who will be signed in as temporary members for the event.

### Event Details
- **Date:** Sunday 13th October 2024
- **Time:** 8pm
- **Location:** TheNCF Collective, 5 Pearse Street, F26 C925
- **Tickets:** [Pre-book here](https://www.eventbrite.ie/e/thencf-presents-as-fanning-badhands-tickets-1017903184827?aff=oddtdtcreator)
